page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorative D; the first word is read as "Dicunt" from the joined initial. The running head's opening letters are a stylised NV ligature, transcribed as NVPTIALES. The "repudiū" word at the end of the second paragraph has an unclear mark over the final vowel, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "T" at the lower right is the first letter of the next page's opening word.
